Lagerstroemia ( / ˌ l eɪ ɡ ər ˈ s t r iː m i ə / ), commonly known as crape myrtle (also commonly spelled crepe myrtle , crape-myrtle , or crapemyrtle ), is a genus of deciduous and evergreen trees and shrubs native to the Indian subcontinent , southeast Asia, northern Australia , and other parts of Oceania, cultivated in warmer climates around the world. [ 1 ] It is a member of the family Lythraceae , which is also known as the loosestrife family. These flowering trees are beautifully colored and are often planted both privately and commercially as ornamentals.
